# California Supreme Court Resources

> > A comprehensive digital archive of California Supreme Court opinions and legal decisions spanning from the 1930s through the 1950s.

This resource provides access to historical California Supreme Court case law, including landmark decisions on employment law, property rights, civil procedure, and constitutional matters. The collection features opinions authored by prominent justices and covers pivotal mid-20th century legal developments in California.

## Key Topics

- California Supreme Court
- Employment Law
- Civil Appeals
- Property Law
- Quiet Title Actions
- Bona Fide Purchaser Rights
- Mandamus Proceedings
- Memorandum Opinions
- James G. Bryant (Director of Employment)
- Fred N. Howser (Attorney General)
- Carter, J.
- Civil Code Section 2911
- Affirmed Judgments
- Loyalty Oath Cases
- 1950s California Law

## Employment Law Cases

- [Hagstrom's Food Stores v. Bryant](https://scocal.stanford.edu/opinion/hagstroms-food-stores-v-bryant-29435): 1950 employment law case between Hagstrom's Food Stores and Bryant
- [Merchants Express Corporation v. Bryant](https://scocal.stanford.edu/opinion/merchants-express-corporation-v-bryant-29438): 1950 employment law appeal by Merchants Express Corporation
- [Bisno v. Leonard](https://scocal.stanford.edu/opinion/bisno-v-leonard-29521): 1952 mandamus case on teacher tenure and loyalty oath at SF State College

## Property Law Cases

- [Gordon v. Rombotis](https://scocal.stanford.edu/opinion/gordon-v-rombotis-26349): 1951 property law case on quiet title and bona fide purchaser rights

## Civil Appeals

- [Islais Co., Ltd., v. Matheson](https://scocal.stanford.edu/opinion/islais-co-ltd-v-matheson-28705): 1935 civil appeal involving Islais Co. and city treasurer Matheson
